description: Read your managed Cap job's cached progress, complete result and receipt for free. Use the platform job_id returned by call_cap. Ordinary reads do not invoke the provider. Set refresh_result: true to explicitly request free renewal of declared result URLs after success; the optional private provider command does not generate new work or change the receipt. Existing orders remain readable after Cap revocation.

job_id.description: Platform job_id from call_cap, starting with ac_.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

refresh_result.description: Optional explicit free renewal of result URLs, when the original Cap declares support; default false.

name: get_cap_job

cancellation.description: Optional timeout notification status; acknowledgement does not prove that provider work stopped.

delivery.description: The provider's declared retention commitment and optional free result URL renewal support.

error_omitted.description: The provider error is omitted from this tool response; read job_url for the full cached document.

job_url.description: Free authenticated GET endpoint for the full cached job document.

result_omitted.description: The complete result is omitted from this tool response; read job_url for the full cached document.
